scientific_integrity: Exactly proved same-model theorem, with exhaustive small rational enumerations; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: One scalar datum and identical-coordinate forward operator
Independent uniformly chosen coordinates and deterministic steps
Exact arithmetic, fixed time horizon and minimum-norm Euclidean reconstruction target
No extension to general noisy ill-posed operators is asserted
Equivalent earlier optimal-weight formulations remain possible
title: Finite-budget reconstruction-optimal steps in rank-one randomized block descent
